verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents its own credential mechanisms that suit agents. It offers named user API tokens with expiration, OAuth 2.1 per-client approval for interactive MCP clients, and personal API keys for headless agent use. Nothing shows these credentials can be limited by permission, workspace, or resource, so least-privilege scoping is unproven. Missing for 10: per-token permission scopes or roles, workspace/resource-restricted tokens, read-only or agent-specific credential types, independent corroboration.
